reproduction: Sign in with a configured role account.
Reload the page or navigate directly to a protected route.
Observe the protected page after hydration.
issues.expected: The refresh session is restored and the protected route remains authenticated.
issues.actual: The browser returns to the signed-out state and shows the sign-in-required experience after reload/direct navigation.
issues.networkError: Browser reproduction did not surface a console network error. Direct API POST /api/v1/auth/refresh succeeds with the configured refresh cookie.
issues.likelyRootCause: Client session hydration/refresh-cookie handling during a full document navigation; API refresh itself is healthy.
issues.recommendedFix: Trace the browser refresh path and cookie/session hydration, then verify persistence across reload and protected-route navigation for all three roles.

reproduction: Compare the public result with the published catalogue recorded on the VPS.
issues.expected: Published beta assets are available in Marketplace, or the empty state clearly explains a controlled beta with no inventory.
issues.actual: The public API returns 200 with zero items and Marketplace renders 0 assets, while the VPS contains 14 PUBLISHED catalogue assets. Core discovery/trading cannot be exercised.
issues.networkError: GET /api/v1/market/assets returns 200 with an empty collection.
issues.likelyRootCause: Public market projection/beta gating is not exposing the published catalogue.
issues.recommendedFix: Decide the intended beta inventory policy, then expose the approved published projection or provide an explicit controlled-beta message and test fixture strategy.

reproduction: Request the linked asset route directly.
issues.expected: The canonical asset detail page loads, or the public showcase does not link to unavailable assets.
issues.actual: The route renders Asset not found. Homepage, portfolio, and order records still contain slice-demo-* asset links.
issues.networkError: Asset detail request resolves to the not-found state.
issues.likelyRootCause: Public UI fixture links are not backed by the public asset projection.
issues.recommendedFix: Use canonical published slugs in public records or remove/gate showcase links until the projection is available.

reproduction: Inspect the featured card and Trending opportunities links.
issues.expected: Live beta public copy uses real published catalogue data, with any illustrative examples clearly isolated and not presented as live market inventory.
issues.actual: The page exposes a static £1,950 Umbreon example, six slice-demo-* links, and Buy/Sell shares — demo only cards as public market content.
issues.networkError: No failed request; content is rendered as static fixture content.
issues.likelyRootCause: Homepage showcase fixture remains enabled during the live-beta transition.
issues.recommendedFix: Gate the showcase behind an explicit showcase/demo mode or replace it with the approved live beta projection.

issues.expected: Only intentional test records are shown, with no stale demo spam or misleading historical submissions.
issues.actual: The list contains multiple cancelled Rayquaza/Charizard/D drafts and other stale demo submissions. VPS read-only counts show 30 submissions owned by the two demo accounts.
issues.networkError: Collector workspace overview, collectibles, requests, documents, subscription, plans, and vaults all returned 200.
issues.likelyRootCause: Historical staging fixture submissions were retained while transitioning to live beta.
issues.recommendedFix: Define a non-destructive fixture retention policy and hide/archive stale demo records from the customer-facing list.

issues.expected: The onboarding checklist contains an explicit Identity Verification step with Verify Identity or Continue Verification, or a clearly marked safe-disabled provider state.
issues.actual: The flow opens Add your phone with Account/Email/Phone/Security/Finish progress. No Identity Verification step or real verification action is visible.
issues.networkError: No Plaid IDV action was issued.
issues.likelyRootCause: Collector onboarding still uses the generic account-setup flow and does not expose the current identity-verification capability/state.
issues.recommendedFix: Expose the existing provider/configuration state and a real start/resume action, or explicitly label the provider as deferred without implying verification is complete.

reproduction: Sign in as the configured admin.
Inspect the header More and Account menus.
Attempt to reach the Admin Console as a normal user.
issues.expected: An authorized admin has a clear, discoverable route to the Admin Console.
issues.actual: No Admin Console link is exposed in the header menus. Direct /admin exists and admin APIs return 200, but full navigation is also affected by AUTH-001.
issues.networkError: Admin API smoke routes returned 200 for the configured admin.
issues.likelyRootCause: Admin route is implemented but omitted from global authenticated navigation.
issues.recommendedFix: Add an admin-only navigation entry after session persistence is corrected.

reproduction: Inspect the overall health and notification subsystem cards.
issues.expected: Operational failures are actionable and intentionally disabled providers are clearly distinguished from degraded systems.
issues.actual: Overall health is Degraded because 7 notification deliveries require review. Provider cards for Plaid, Bridge, and market data report Unknown/configured false rather than a clear Not configured/deferred state.
issues.likelyRootCause: Notification delivery failures are present in staging and provider telemetry uses an Unknown fallback.
issues.recommendedFix: Resolve or explicitly suppress staging notification failures, and render configured/disabled/unknown provider states with unambiguous operator guidance.

reproduction: Exercise public routes at 390, 768, and 1920 CSS pixels.
Inspect document scroll width and capture console output.
issues.expected: No horizontal overflow, clipping, or console errors.
issues.actual: No horizontal overflow or console errors were observed on the tested public routes.
issues.networkError: None observed on tested public routes.
issues.recommendedFix: No fix required from this audit pass.
